matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 61/100 (above average) against BUF's run defense at 6/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing: the Patriots roll into Buffalo with exactly one statistical superpower, and it's the kind of superpower that matters against the Bills' Swiss-cheese run defense. Our rush offense grades at 61—above average—while Buffalo's run defense sits at a catastrophic 6 out of 100, the widest edge on the board this week. So naturally, we'll be deeply curious to see if the Patriots actually *use* that edge, given the ongoing debates about how Drake Maye is being deployed. The real nightmare, though, is what's waiting on the other side: our pass protection grades at 13 (nightmare fuel), our pass offense at 23 (grim), and we're about to face Buffalo's 68-ranked pass rush in a 1 p.m. afternoon game where they can tee off early. We're +7 underdogs in a stadium that's always hostile, coming off recent form that's been marginally negative while the Bills trend slightly positive. This is a game we absolutely have to win in the trenches, and if we can't punish that run defense, the pressure situations will find Drake Maye in all the wrong ways.
